With 7 claims, the zero rate is weak evidence.","The example C0090199 (99214, low MDM, 28 minutes) is a 99214 below-billed case that does not support any point about 99215 upcoding. The set also omits the documentation-supported 99215 examples such as C0090267 and C0090280, which are low-complexity patients with high MDM documented. That evidence cuts against the suspicion and would have been informative.","Only 2 low-complexity 99215 examples are cited out of 16, and the strongest ones (0 conditions, e.g. C0090267, C0090409) are not picked.","The summary does not give the complexity gradient (17% 99215 share at 1 condition vs 54.5% at 5+), and it never states that 2 of 57 patients with 0 conditions had 99215.
